title: More Chickens
description: Adds special chickens, elemental eggs with upgrade tiers, an Egg Carton block, rare loot, breeding features, advancements, and a 2-phase Chicken King boss with special attacks.
body:
More Chickens is a Minecraft Fabric mod that expands the normal chicken gameplay with new special chickens, powerful eggs, rare loot, breeding mechanics and extra survival features.

The mod adds multiple custom chicken variants, special egg items, new food items, crafting recipes and loot mechanics while still keeping the Minecraft style.

Features

- Special chicken variants
- OP Chicken
- Explosive Chicken
- Boost Chicken
- Custom chicken spawn eggs
- OP Egg
- Explosive Eggs
- Boost Eggs
- Fried Egg
- OP Eat Egg
- Rare loot drops
- Special breeding mechanics
- Egg upgrade recipes
- Chicken-themed survival progression

Special Chickens

OP Chicken

The OP Chicken is a rare special chicken that can drop valuable loot and lay OP Eggs.

Explosive Chicken

The Explosive Chicken is a Nether-themed chicken that lays Explosive Eggs and drops explosive items.

Boost Chicken

The Boost Chicken is an End-themed chicken that lays Boost Eggs and adds movement-based gameplay.

Eggs

More Chickens adds multiple new egg types:

- OP Egg
- Explosive Egg I
- Explosive Egg II
- Explosive Egg III
- Explosive Egg IV
- Explosive Egg V
- Explosive Egg VI
- Explosive Egg VII
- Explosive Egg VIII
- Explosive Egg C
- Boost Egg I
- Boost Egg II
- Boost Egg III
- Boost Egg IV
- Boost Egg V
- Boost Egg VI
- Boost Egg VII
- Boost Egg VIII
- Boost Egg C
- Fried Egg
- OP Eat Egg

Explosive Eggs and Boost Eggs can be upgraded by crafting two eggs of the same tier into the next tier.

Breeding

Special chickens have their own breeding items:

- OP Chicken: Wheat Seeds
- Explosive Chicken: Gunpowder
- Boost Chicken: Wind Charge

Food

Fried Egg can be used as a food item.
OP Eat Egg is a stronger food item crafted from Fried Eggs.

Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.1
2. Install Fabric API
3. Download More Chickens
4. Put the .jar file into your mods folder
5. Start Minecraft with Fabric

Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Java 21

Notes

This mod is still being improved. More chickens, items, textures, models and features may be added in future updates.
